Sandbox_SacrificialOffering_AnimalCorpse: Recovery contribution of a 100 kg intact animal carcass. Actual carcass weight scales the result. A single large animal is capped at recovery strength 15 unless this configured baseline is higher. Butchered animal heads are accepted. Animal recovery accumulates only to the rare-item ceiling each life.
Sandbox_SacrificialOffering_RareItemReco: Recovery contribution of a pristine accepted rare-item recipe. By default, two pristine offerings reach full recovery. Another attempt during that life invokes wrath. Damaged or broken items and partly filled or empty clips reduce recovery strength.
Sandbox_SacrificialOffering_AcceptableIt: List of acceptable sacrificial items for Mid-Tier. Semicolons separate alternatives. Plus joins required items. Use count*Full.Type for quantities. Do not add wrapping quotes. Example: Base.Sledgehammer;Base.Katana;Base.AssaultRifle+3*Base.556Clip
Sandbox_SacrificialOffering_PlayerCorpse: When enabled, a successful sacrifice of another player's tagged corpse creates the configured prize items on the ground beside the sacrificer. Disabled by default.

Items dropped after a successful corpse sacrifice of another player. Separate entries with semicolons, commas, or plus signs. Quantities use count*Module.Item. Example: Base.GoldBar;2*Base.GoldCoin. 100 items is the prize maximum per sacrifice.
Sandbox_SacrificialOffering_WrathMinimum: Minimum wrath health deduction strength. Default = 17
Minimum health points removed by wrath. Character health uses a 0-100 scale.
Sandbox_SacrificialOffering_WrathMaximum: Maximum wrath health deduction strength. Default = 65
Maximum health points removed by wrath. Wrath can be lethal to an already injured character or cause them to bleed out.
Sandbox_SacrificialOffering_MinimumTempl: Smallest drawable temple rectangle. Seven tiles leaves room for all five fixtures.
Sandbox_SacrificialOffering_MaximumTempl: Largest drawable temple rectangle, limiting accidental or abusive claims.
Sandbox_SacrificialOffering_TraceLogging: Adds debug and integrity-pass entries to the normal META RUN transaction logs. Leave disabled for routine servers.
Sandbox_SacrificialOffering_AllowAllPlay: Allow all players to view Satanic Temples on the world map

When enabled, the world‑map right‑click option to toggle the Satanic Temples overlay is visible to every player. This does not grant any zone‑editing permissions; creating or editing temples remains admin‑only.
